title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 16, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $1,750.00
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 16, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $1,750.00
  for Critical Incident Review Division’s Wellness Day, as set forth.  [BPC #26-365]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and ACCEPT the donation.
summary: The Police Commission is asked to accept a $1,750 donation for the Critical Incident Review Division's Wellness Day.
